triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER clients_invalidate_drafts AFTER UPDATE OF name, logo_asset_id ON public.clients FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.name IS DISTINCT FROM new.name) OR (old.logo_asset_id IS DISTINCT FROM new.logo_asset_id))) EXECUTE FUNCTION eps.invalidate_central_drafts()
triggers.name: clients_invalidate_drafts

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER projects_invalidate_drafts AFTER UPDATE OF name ON public.projects FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.name IS DISTINCT FROM new.name)) EXECUTE FUNCTION eps.invalidate_central_drafts()
